description: Where Jest 30.5.2's babel provider counts (`coverage.istanbulVariable`, T8.10, B23b): a test reads `globalThis.__coverage__`, finds the one instrumented module under its path, and sees a call move its function counter there. Both tests pass only when the global has that name. The text summary is recorded too. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage.test.ts` and the policy claim for `coverage.istanbulVariable`.
